profiles.name: SF6
profiles.description: Universal tests plus explicitly authored SF6 tests.

tests.name: Normal hit
tests.instruction: Land the move once on a standing opponent and let the move finish.

tests.name: Guard
tests.instruction: Have the opponent block the move once and let the move finish.

tests.name: Air hit
tests.instruction: Hit an airborne opponent and review the reaction, spark, velocity, and recovery.

tests.name: Corner interaction
tests.instruction: Hit or guard the move with the opponent fully against the stage wall.

tests.name: Raw standing hit
tests.instruction: Hit a standing P2 once with a raw sLP, then let the move finish.

tests.name: Standing guard
tests.instruction: Have standing P2 block one sLP, then let the move finish.

tests.name: Counter Hit
tests.instruction: Choose Counter Hit in player-facing Hit & Counter Settings, then hit interruptible startup.

tests.name: Punish Counter
tests.instruction: Choose Punish Counter in player-facing Hit & Counter Settings, then hit punishable recovery.

tests.name: Corner recoil
tests.instruction: Hit or guard sLP with P2 fully against the stage wall.

tests.name: Air hit
tests.instruction: Hit an airborne P2 with sLP.

tests.name: Armor absorption
tests.instruction: Enable one-hit armor on P2 and let it absorb sLP.

tests.name: Armor Break
tests.instruction: Enable armor on P2 and hit it with sLP armor-break enabled.

diagnostics.name: Toggle collision boxes
diagnostics.help: Shows or hides collision boxes for all visible actors.

diagnostics.name: Next player or helper debug
diagnostics.help: Cycles the selected root/helper native debug readout.

diagnostics.name: Next debug target + CLSN
diagnostics.help: Cycles the native debug target and includes its collision boxes.

diagnostics.name: Toggle all-player debug
diagnostics.help: Shows or hides native debug information for all players.

diagnostics.name: Toggle wireframe
diagnostics.help: Shows the engine wireframe display.

diagnostics.name: Toggle lifebar
diagnostics.help: Shows or hides the fight UI without changing the motif files.

diagnostics.name: Toggle VSync
diagnostics.help: Changes the native VSync debug state for this run.

diagnostics.name: Cycle game speed
diagnostics.help: Cycles the native debug speed presets.

diagnostics.name: Increase speed by 0.01
diagnostics.help: Fine speed adjustment.

diagnostics.name: Decrease speed by 0.01
diagnostics.help: Fine speed adjustment.

diagnostics.name: Pause / resume
diagnostics.help: Uses IKEMEN's native pause authority.

diagnostics.name: Advance one frame
diagnostics.help: Advances one frame while paused.

diagnostics.name: KO P2 team
diagnostics.help: Sets the active P2 team to KO through IKEMEN's native debug authority.

diagnostics.name: KO P1 team
diagnostics.help: Sets the active P1 team to KO through IKEMEN's native debug authority.

diagnostics.name: Set all life to 1
diagnostics.help: Sets every active player to one life for KO-flow testing.

diagnostics.name: Fill P1 and P2 power
diagnostics.help: Fills both teams' native power meters.

diagnostics.name: Toggle maximum-power mode
diagnostics.help: Toggles the engine's continuous maximum-power debug mode.

diagnostics.name: Reset training
diagnostics.help: Resets the current training situation.

diagnostics.name: Reload files
diagnostics.help: Reloads game content for rapid iteration.

diagnostics.name: Set timer to zero
diagnostics.help: Triggers native time-over flow for round and UI testing.

diagnostics.name: Save state
diagnostics.help: Stores the engine-owned battle snapshot.

diagnostics.name: Load state
diagnostics.help: Restores the engine-owned battle snapshot.

diagnostics.name: Clear console
diagnostics.help: Clears the native console output.

diagnostics.name: Force all standing
diagnostics.help: Forces active roots into standing state for setup. This is not hit classification.

diagnostics.name: Full restore
diagnostics.help: Restores life and power for active players and resets the timer.
